customer_summary.template: Summarise the authorised customer context. Separate known facts from uncertainty and cite every material point.

field_extraction.template: Extract only the requested fields from the supplied authorised text. Use null for missing values and never infer unsupported facts.

next_step_recommendation.template: Recommend one reviewable next step grounded in authorised customer context. Do not execute or imply that an action was executed.

communication_draft.template: Draft a communication using only authorised context. Produce a draft for human review and do not send it.

workflow_plan.template: Propose a bounded workflow plan from authorised context. Every proposed action must remain typed, approval-gated, and unexecuted.
